zh.title: Grok Bot 是什么
bullets: 三层架构：Jarvis（云端主控 Bot）→ Vision（Linux 云主机）→ Friday（本地 Mac 工作站）
DN-B 编排：Driver = dsh / deepseek-flash（effort max）；Navigator = Codex CLI gpt-6-astra（长流程 -p max）
审代码优先 Codex CLI（档位 ≥ 编程任务），Paseo 审查代理兜底

en.title: What is Grok Bot
bullets: Three layers: Jarvis (cloud chief bot) → Vision (Linux cloud host) → Friday (local Mac workstation)
DN-B: Driver = dsh / deepseek-flash (effort max); Navigator = Codex CLI gpt-6-astra (long flows -p max)
Code review prefers Codex CLI (effort ≥ coding task); Paseo reviewer as fallback
Built-in X public reads: search posts / user posts / news / trends (no personal developer key required)
